title: Prenatal Alcohol Exposure and Congenital Heart Defects: A Meta-Analysis.
authors: Yang J, Qiu H, Qu P, Zhang R, Zeng L, Yan H.
quote: No association was found in the pooled result from the two studies investigated the relationship between prenatal alcohol exposure and atrioventricular septal defects (AVSDs) (OR = 1.41, 95%CI = 0.57 -3.50).
